title: THE CHEESE MOD
description: this mod adds cheese ore that can be used to get cheese blocks and cheese.
body:
LAYNE'S CHEESE MOD 🧀
My first Minecraft mod ever released!

This mod adds cheese to Minecraft. There may still be a few bugs, but more updates are planned in the future.

Features
🧀 Cheese Ore

-Generates in caves and drops cheese when mined.

🧀 Deepslate Cheese Ore

-Generates in deepslate caves and also drops cheese.

🧀 Cheese

-A brand-new food item.

🧀 Block of Cheese

-Craft a decorative cheese block using 9 pieces of cheese.

Known Bugs
-I know no bugs please find them out and tell me.

Coming in the Next Update
-Nether Cheese

-End Cheese

More cheese coming soon!
